I managed to get the FISP coupon this year, so I will put chemical fertilizer on this main maize plot — it is the most important plot for feeding my family, and I want to make sure we get a good harvest. I will also use the improved maize seed that came with the subsidy program because it yields better than the local seed. I do not have livestock or enough compost for manure, and pesticides are too expensive for a food crop like maize, so I will not use those. We rely entirely on the rains in Machinga, so I cannot irrigate. I expect my family to spend about three weeks of labor on this plot over the season, mostly for weeding and harvesting, but since it is only 0.13 hectares, we should manage without hiring extra help.
